mechanics.claim: If the two Stretching Strikes hit different enemies, Zac will fling them together to knock up and stun them, dealing magic damage to all surrounding enemies.
mechanics.quote: If the two ''Stretching Strikes'' hit different enemies, '''Zac''' will fling them together to briefly {{tip|airborne|knock up}} and {{tip|stun}} them, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all surrounding enemies.

mechanics.claim: While the tether persists, Zac's next basic attack is replaced by a second Stretching Strike with a 0.25s cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''Zac's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a second ''Stretching Strike'', empowering it to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack triggers on-attack effects but cannot critically strike nor apply on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: This attack triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but cannot {{tip|critically strike}} nor apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: If both Stretching Strikes affect the same target, the target is dealt the damage and applied the slow for both hits (i.e. twice).
mechanics.quote: If both ''Stretching Strikes'' affect the same target, the target will be dealt the damage and applied the slow for both hits.

mechanics.claim: Both Stretching Strikes (cast and empowered attack) reset Zac's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Both Stretching Strikes (the cast and the empowered attack) {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zac's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts after the ability's effect resolves (post-effect), not on cast.
